title: Not worth it. Do not get a subscription.
text:
I was roped in by some advertisement that showed great experiments.
I purchased a yearly subscription. the first kit was great. Had all the makings of a chemistry set along with a way to watch VR videos on a phone. Then the next kit came.
These are packaged so well. Makes them look so professional. You are paying for that. The experiments take a few minutes and honestly, I think you can get these at the dollar stores. I cancelled after the second kit after first great one.
I also did not know that these ship from the UK. One kit took 45 days to get to me. Don't know where it comes from if you get it through Amazon, but please don't fall into the trap I did and get an expensive subscription of simplistic experiments.
label: negative
